site_url.description: Our website, e.g. https://www.example.com. A bare host gets https://.

serps.description: One search per focus keyword, from earlier search steps: each item is a raw Tavily, Brave Search, SerpApi or Exa output (optionally wrapped as {"step": {"ok", "data"}} or {"ok", "data"}), a plain list of {url, title}, or {"keyword": ..., "results": <any of those>}. The first 5 are compared.

focus_keywords.description: The keywords, in the same order as serps; used when a search output does not name its query.

pages.description: The page audit's pages[] (website-seo-page-audit). Its final_url, title, h1 and h2 pick our page for a keyword we do not rank for.

max_competitors.description: Top results on other sites to read per keyword. Default 5.
